interface.signature: def scramble(s: str, indices: list[int]) -> str:

preconditions.description: The string `s` and the list of indices must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: Every index in `indices` must be a valid position within the bounds of the string `s`.

postconditions.description: The returned string has the same length as the input string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[indices[i]] for i in range(len(indices)))
postconditions.description: For each position `i` in the returned string, the character at `i` is the character from `s` at the index specified by `indices[i]`.
